method: CP-SAT ground generation on request dimensions, with library solutions as unlocked hints; no cached fallback

ground_search.model_scope: Request-defined ground room graph; south street and north stair entry; limited architectural topology.

assumptions: Plan-level, eye height within open door/window height
All modelled door and window apertures treated as transparent
Openings enlarged 50 mm at each jamb for conservative sampling
Finite observer/target samples; not an exhaustive visibility proof
Bedroom targets are an interior zone, not a furnished bed
Curtains, glazing opacity, door leaves and upper-floor views unmodelled
